Description
A holiday favorite, the PEZ® Gift Set returns this season with a new special 2023 design. This set contains perfect replica pure silver wafers of the nostalgic PEZ® candies and an authentic matching dispenser. This year’s holiday gift set features a playful reindeer! Limited mintage of 3,000 sets. The silver wafers are not edible.
Main Highlights
of the PAMP Suisse PEZ® Reindeer Silver
6 * 5 gram
Wafers & Dispenser Gift Set
Contains (6) 5 gram .999 fine silver wafers for a total of 30 grams of .999 fine silver.
This product is 100% sold out at the mint!
Limited mintage to only 3,000 gift sets worldwide.
Each PEZ® silver candy replica comes encapsulated and accompanied with a novelty candy dispenser with a special reindeer design.
Obverse: Features the iconic PEZ® name.
Reverse: Displays the weight and purity along with an adorable reindeer.
Manufactured and guaranteed by PAMP Suisse.
